description: This file defines a Perl module implementing an SVN delta editor tailored for git-svn operations. It provides methods to generate diffs, apply changes, manage properties, and facilitate synchronization between git trees and a Subversion repository.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl module that extends SVN::Delta::Editor to provide a commit driver for git-svn operations, handling diff generation, change application, property management, and synchronization between git trees and SVN repositories.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Editor object with provided options, generating diffs and checking paths.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two trees using svn diff-tree command with options for copy similarity, copies, and renames.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the types of paths involved in the diff, caching directory or file status.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path for a given file path, encoding it if necessary.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs a full URL path for a given repository path, escaping characters if the URL is HTTP/HTTPS.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories marked for deletion by generating svn ls-tree output and deleting entries.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens an existing directory or adds a new one in the SVN repository based on its type.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that a particular directory path exists in the SVN repository, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern into a regular expression for matching file names.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches a pattern to automatically set properties.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies auto properties to a file based on configuration patterns.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks SVN attributes for a given file path.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manual properties from SVN to a file based on checked attributes.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new file during diff application.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles copying or moving a file from one path to another.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Deletes an entry in the SVN repository.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles renaming or replacing a file by deleting and adding.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Handles modification of a file.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles toggling file modes (e.g., symlinks) by replacing the file.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes a file property in SVN.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes a directory property in SVN.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob for a file, handling special files and checksums.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Applies changes to a file, updating its contents and properties.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the editing session, closing directories.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the editing session, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Executes the sequence of file operations based on collected diffs and applies them to the SVN repository.
